# EfficientFormer-V2

**Category:** Efficient/Mobile · **Code:**
[`timm/models/efficientformer_v2.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/efficientformer_v2.py)
· **Architectures:** 4 · **Pretrained weights:** 4 (4 with ImageNet-1k results)

EfficientFormer-V2 revisits the EfficientFormer design to reduce both parameter count and latency for mobile devices,
with convolutional stages and attention in the later, lower resolution stages.

## Papers

* [Rethinking Vision Transformers for MobileNet Size and Speed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.08059)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('efficientformerv2_l.snap_dist_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

## Model API support

| Feature | `EfficientFormerV2` |
|---|---|
| [`features_only=True` feature maps](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ (strides 4, 8, 16, 32) |
| [`forward_intermediates()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ |
| [`prune_intermediate_layers()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ |
| [Any input size, no changes needed](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`set_input_size()`](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`dynamic_img_size=True`](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`EfficientFormerV2` with `efficientformerv2_s0`
at 224), other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page
for details.

## Architectures

| Architecture | Params (M) | GMACs | Input size | Pretrained weights |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `efficientformerv2_l` | 26.32 | 2.59 | 224 | 1 |
| `efficientformerv2_s0` | 3.60 | 0.41 | 224 | 1 |
| `efficientformerv2_s1` | 6.19 | 0.67 | 224 | 1 |
| `efficientformerv2_s2` | 12.71 | 1.27 | 224 | 1 |

GMACs and parameter counts are for the default input size and classifier of each architecture, from the [benchmark
results](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/tree/main/results).

size of the pretrained classifier, none for weights without one.
